name: Revo Micro
description: The E3D Revo Micro is the ultra-compact member of the Revo ecosystem, engineered for lightweight toolheads where mass is at a premium. Originally designed in collaboration with the Voron community for the Voron V0, it brings the Revo RapidChange nozzle system to the smallest possible footprint. The integrated HeatCore combines heater and thermistor into a single component, reducing wiring complexity and enabling tool-free nozzle swaps without waiting for the hotend to cool.

physicalSpecs.mountType: Revo Micro mount (Voron V0 compatible, various third-party mounts)

features: Tool-free nozzle changes at operating temperature
Ultra-compact form factor for lightweight toolheads
Designed for Voron V0 and similar compact printers
Part of the broader Revo ecosystem with shared nozzles
